description: dt worktree and dt land — cut a second checkout of a dreamteamer workspace, and bring its committed records home.

dreamteamer.title: Worktrees
dreamteamer.description: The worktree lifecycle: `dt worktree add|list|get|rm` cuts, lists, inspects and removes linked checkouts of the workspace (each installed and compiled, on branch `worktree-<name>`), and `dt land` rebases a worktree's commits onto the primary branch, resolves only conflicts inside a generated block, checks, fast-forwards, recompiles and retires it. Ships the WorktreeCreate / WorktreeRemove hooks for a coding agent and the `working-in-worktrees` skill.
